name: Idris Vatsa
career: Senior policy counsel for a state athletic commission
bio: Idris spends most weekdays drafting licensing rules, reviewing event-safety plans, and fielding calls from promoters trying to get boxing and MMA cards approved without cutting corners. After work, he is more likely to watch a Terence Crawford breakdown, a Canelo press conference, or an old ROH match than anything from the NFL highlight machine. His playlists lean heavily toward classic East Coast underground rap, especially The Artifacts, though he also keeps Nigerian comedy skits in rotation when he needs a quick reset. A surprising point of pride is his tiny balcony collection of carefully labeled dwarf citrus trees, which he waters with the same methodical calm he brings to regulatory hearings.
